semanticRules: Non-menu actors: racer (values exactly vx,vy,vz, finite within+-100; editable; actual motion), obstacle_0..5, ring_0..4, gate_0..2, road. racer actual pose is editable x within+-5.5,z2..track.length+2,y=road height at z + craft.hover_height within0.15. Road height is triangular ramp from ramp_start height0 through ramp_peak ramp_height to ramp_end height0. This is the actual visible terrain. Live racer has racing/present=true; destroyed when shield0/lost (may remain visible). Obstacles/road no values, fixed visible content geometry. Ring and gate values empty, states as named.

track and mode agree with entry; vehicle identifies content tuning. Shield<=that vehicle capacity. speed mirrors nonnegative forward velocity; normal velocity vz=speed, vx=steer*vehicle.steering; y follows ramp. countdown>0 requires elapsed=0,speed=0,boost=0,next_gate=0 and spawn pose. next_gate is count of correctly crossed gates (0..3); gate states passed iff index<next_gate. Already passed gates must be at or behind racer z. A later z with missing gates is legal but cannot retroactively pass them. Ring states may be edited as legal collection history, ring absent iff collected.

Editable fields are vehicle/shield/speed/elapsed/countdown/next_gate/score/best_time/completed_mask/boost/steer and racer pose/velocity/ring states, with real cross-field consistency. Playing/paused requires shield>0,next_gate<3; won requires next_gate=3 and z>=finish; lost requires shield0 or distance mode elapsed>=time_limit. Do not set a new outcome through preparation. Preserve collision grace and other timing in opaqueData; fixture positions may be on an unobstructed legal approach to an obstacle/ring/gate. Each prepared case starts outside the thing it will collide with/collect/cross.

OpenEntry resets the selected track/mode to craft0 normal countdown; normal menus can choose all four crafts. best_time is current track/craft successful record (0=none). completed_mask bit=(track-1)*2+mode. DescribeCurrentEntry returns actual spawn,board-center,finish,ramp-peak. State IDs do not prescribe internal object names.

One active IGameSession. Capture has exactly the declared top-level numbers. Each present actor resolves uniquely to its actual visible/interactable gameplay root, not a reporting proxy, and reports its actual transform.position. Facing is +1 except a visibly left-facing actor may use -1. Actor entryId equals the current entry. Unknown/duplicate identities, wrong version, nonfinite or out-of-range values and illegal cross-field combinations are atomically rejected. Preserve opaqueData from this candidate's own capture; explicitly editable public fields take precedence over opaqueData.

OpenEntry and Restore complete with gameplay suspended until ResumeSimulation; UI, rendering and reads continue. Release of this suspension does not unpause phase=paused. Capture is detached and side-effect-free. Restore establishes a legal initial situation, never performs the next attack, placement, collision, kill or victory on behalf of the player. Input latches and transient visuals must be restored consistently.

Control actors use the exact listed IDs, kind=control, state=normal, no numeric values. Include only controls that are currently present, or report present=false. ResolveActor returns the real visible uGUI button root. These identities locate ordinary input targets, not action methods. No Dashboard or additional probe is required.

Menu snapshots still have a valid entryId and complete numeric set. World actors may be omitted in menu. Non-menu snapshots include all fixed content identities; absent/dead/unused actors have present=false and ResolveActor may return null. Dynamic projectiles, when present, have stable IDs projectile_<monotonic integer> and preserve their own timing/pose through opaqueData.
